UserBackup.title: UserBackup
UserBackup.description: User pedagogical application state backup bound to a verified Google email and UID

appData.description: Compressed or serialized JSON string of the application state

isCompressed.description: Whether the payload is Gzip compressed

isChunked.description: Whether the backup payload is split across subcollection chunks

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the last update

lastSavedTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last update

userEmail.description: Verified email address of the authenticated teacher (must match request.auth.token.email)

ownerUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the teacher (must match request.auth.uid)

emailVerified.description: Confirmation that the account email is verified via Google Auth

BackupChunk.title: BackupChunk
BackupChunk.description: Subcollection chunk for large compressed application backups bound to a verified owner

chunk.description: Slice of the serialized or compressed backup string

totalChunks.description: Total number of chunks in the backup

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp when this chunk was written

userEmail.description: Verified email address of the authenticated teacher

ownerUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the teacher

/users/{userId}.description: Stores the primary backup metadata and payload strictly bound to the authenticated teacher's UID and verified email

/users/{userId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Stores individual payload slices when a verified teacher's backup exceeds 600KB
